# Anoop Sinkaran
**Senior Quality Engineer | Mobile & Payments Automation Specialist | QA Lead**

Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

---

### Executive Summary

Seasoned Senior Quality Engineer with over 19 years of enterprise experience delivering end-to-end testing strategies across native iOS and Android mobile applications, payment architectures, and integrated digital services. Proven expertise in establishing mobile test automation frameworks, integrating quality controls into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and leveraging modern AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Generative AI to accelerate delivery cycles. Accomplished QA leader with strong domain knowledge in financial services and payments, adept at risk-based testing, cross-functional defect triage, release assurance, and embedding quality practices across Agile teams.

---

### Core Competencies & Technical Skills

* **Mobile & Web Test Automation:** Native iOS & Android Testing, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Robolectric, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose.
* **API & Domain Integration:** Card Payment Processing & Schemes, Payment Message ISO/APACS Standards, Terminal Licensing & Onboarding Gateways, API Gateway Regression Automation, Digital Wallets.
* **CI/CD & DevOps Engineering:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Automated PR Review Workflows, Slack API Integration, GitHub.
* **Artificial Intelligence & AI Tooling:** GitHub Copilot (Custom SKILL Creation & CLI), Generative AI Prompting, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), Dynatrace Observability.
* **Quality Leadership & Strategy:** Risk-Based Testing, QA Team Leadership, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Cross-Functional Release Management, Data Integrity Validation, Agile/Scrum (JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM).
* **Languages & Frameworks:** Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, .NET, React, JavaScript, TypeScript.
